name: kairo-ai-chatbot
description: Kairo – full-stack AI chat app (Next.js + Express + MongoDB + OpenAI)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
